anomalies.description: Two individuals in dark wetsuits engage in sustained physical combat on a beach at sunset, involving grappling, lifting, throwing, and striking motions.

Two individuals engage in mutual physical combat on a beach: one initiates an attack (f0), the other responds with a defensive/counter move (f1), they grapple and exchange blows (f2–f3), and the struggle continues with close contact (f4).

After a brief separation, the two individuals re-engage in close physical combat near the rock formation, with visible grappling and body contact (f7–f8), continuing through f9 where one appears to be pushing or striking the other.

A final burst of physical engagement occurs: one person is bent over while the other stands close in an aggressive posture, suggesting a strike or takedown attempt (f14–f15).; Two individuals engage in close-quarters physical combat on a beach; one person is seen grabbing and lifting the other, followed by a chokehold or headlock from above (overhead shot at f2/f3), indicating mutual aggressive engagement.

One individual appears to be restraining or subduing the other in a vulnerable position on the ground, with the victim’s face contorted in distress (f4–f5) and subsequent embrace appearing coercive rather than consensual (f4–f6), suggesting an imbalance of power and non-consensual control.
Two individuals engage in mutual physical combat on a beach at sunset, involving grappling, throws, and ground fighting.
After separating, the two individuals resume combat with running and striking motions, indicating continued mutual engagement.
Two individuals engage in close physical combat on a rocky cliff face; one person is actively striking or pushing the other, who is climbing or clinging to the rock.

One individual lies motionless on the sand while the other stands over and then kneels beside them, delivering repeated strikes to the head/face area; the victim appears incapacitated and unable to defend themselves.
A person lies on the ground, visibly injured (blood on face), while another individual repeatedly strikes or presses down on them in a sustained assault.

A person is lying on the sand, visibly distressed and struggling, while another individual in dark clothing repeatedly strikes or presses down on their head and upper body. The victim's face shows pain and exertion (eyes squeezed shut, mouth open), and the attacker’s hands are seen making forceful contact in multiple frames.

One person lies supine and appears helpless on the sand while another is positioned over them, delivering forceful motions (visible as motion blur in f1–f5), consistent with attacking a non-resisting victim.
Two individuals engage in close physical combat on the sand; one is on the ground while the other is on top, with visible struggle and motion blur indicating active grappling and striking.
After the throw, one person remains on the ground while the other sits/leans over them in a dominant position, suggesting continued control or assault of a helpless individual.
